name: soft_bool_weight2.k
model:
class SoftBool2 {
  a:Bool
  b:Bool
  c:Bool

  req c = !(a && b)

  soft req c

  soft req a weight 2

  soft req b weight 2
}

main:SoftBool2
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftBool2 (mk-SoftBool2 (a Bool)(b Bool)(c Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SoftBool2 (sel-SoftBool2 SoftBool2))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftBool2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftBool2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftBool2 ((this Ref)) SoftBool2
  (sel-SoftBool2 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftBool2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftBool2 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftBool2:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftBool2.a: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2!a ((this Ref)) Bool
  (a (deref-SoftBool2 this))
)

; --- getters for SoftBool2.b: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2!b ((this Ref)) Bool
  (b (deref-SoftBool2 this))
)

; --- getters for SoftBool2.c: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2!c ((this Ref)) Bool
  (c (deref-SoftBool2 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftBool2 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftBool2:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SoftBool2 SoftBool2)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftBool2!c this) (not (and (SoftBool2!a this) (SoftBool2!b this))))
)

(assert (! (SoftBool2.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Soft Constraint 2: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2.soft2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBool2!c this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBool2.soft2 1) :weight 1 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 3: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2.soft3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBool2!a this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBool2.soft3 1) :weight 2 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 4: ---

(define-fun SoftBool2.soft4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBool2!b this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBool2.soft4 1) :weight 2 :id k_soft)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SoftBool2 const-1-SoftBool2))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (and (a (sel-SoftBool2 (select heap 1)))
                (b (sel-SoftBool2 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (c (sel-SoftBool2 (select heap 1))) (not a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SoftBool2 a!1)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun const-1-SoftBool2 () SoftBool2
  (mk-SoftBool2 true true false))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-SoftBool2 (mk-SoftBool2 true true false))))
